items.headline: CeeDee Lamb’s late TD caps a wild Cowboys rally to beat winless Texans 34-30
items.description: — CeeDee Lamb had a career-high 17 catches for 189 yards and his 12-yard TD reception with 40 seconds left lifted the Dallas Cowboys to a 34-30 win over Houston on Sunday to keep the Texans winless.
